dialogs.about: 비 오는 날 손주와 집에서 카드놀이를 함

lines.en: Grandma, let's play a game today!
lines.ko: 할머니, 오늘 놀이 한 판 해요.

lines.en: Good idea. Chess or cards?
Cards, please. I will deal them now.
Wait. Where are the two dice?
lines.ko: 잠깐요. 주사위 두 개는 어디 있어요?

lines.en: On the shelf. Do we need them?
No. Let's just count our score today.
Okay. Please don't cheat, Grandma!
I never cheat! Last year you won every game.
lines.ko: 저는 안 속여요! 작년에는 늘 네가 이겼어요.

lines.en: That was luck. Today I will win again!
lines.ko: 그건 운이었어요. 오늘도 제가 이길 거예요!

lines.en: We will see. The prize is one cookie!

dialogs.about: 마을 회관 놀이 모임에서 처음 만난 상대와 한 판을 시작함

lines.en: Hello. Are you my opponent today?
Yes, I am. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too. Do you like chess?
I learned chess from my grandpa long ago.
Wonderful. Today we play cards. Should I deal first?
lines.ko: 좋네요. 오늘은 카드를 해요. 제가 먼저 돌릴까요?

lines.en: Please do. I hope for good luck today.
lines.ko: 그래 주세요. 오늘은 운이 좋으면 좋겠어요.

lines.en: No one can cheat here. A teacher is watching us.
lines.ko: 여기서는 속일 수 없어요. 선생님이 보고 계세요.

lines.en: Good. What is the prize today?
A small book. I will try to win!
Then let's start. I will write our score.
